**Plugins page (recommended):** open DSH → **Plugins**, then add
`@nakie-zjm/dsh-session-delete@0.1.1`. The installer adds the profile dependency,
selects the bundle in `dsh.profile.bundles`, and the package's own
`cordis.patch.yml` applies as a layer — no configuration file is edited by hand.
**Desktop requires a full app restart**, because bundle selection is read at startup.

**CLI:**

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add @nakie-zjm/dsh-session-delete@0.1.1
dsh plugin --profile web     add @nakie-zjm/dsh-session-delete@0.1.1
```

The official Desktop build does not put `dsh` on `PATH`; register the bundled
command first (**Manage dsh Command…** in the app menu) and use the `desktop`
profile after fully quitting the app.

**Manual fallback:** in `~/.dsh/profiles/<profile>`, run
`pnpm add @nakie-zjm/dsh-session-delete@0.1.1`, then confirm the name appears in
both `dependencies` and `dsh.profile.bundles` of that profile's `package.json`.

**Uninstall:** `dsh plugin --profile desktop remove @nakie-zjm/dsh-session-delete`,
or use the Plugins page. Uninstalling never deletes existing sessions.

**Compatibility:** built and verified against DSH **`0.2.0-rc.2`**.

### Behaviour

in the session row's `…` menu. No hover button.

plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-multi-chat

**Side-by-side sessions for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI, as an equal-cell grid.**
Click a session in the left sidebar and it joins the conversation area as its own pane: one
click → one session, three clicks → three sessions. At most **three panes per row**; the grid
degrades to two or one column when the window is narrow. The session you clicked (the shell's
current session) stays highlighted, every pane keeps its own bottom-pinned input box, and panes
can be reordered by dragging the **⠿ handle in the top-right corner** of a pane header.

中文说明：[README.zh.md](README.zh.md) · 设计依据：[docs/design.md](docs/design.md) ·
Design notes (EN): [docs/design.en.md](docs/design.en.md)

---

## What it does

| | |
|---|---|
| **Follow the sidebar** | Every session you click in the sidebar becomes a pane. The pane order survives a page reload. |
| **Equal-cell grid** | At most three equal cells per row (`3 × 3` = 9 panes max, six by default). Rows share the height but never below a comfortable pane height (~420 px); beyond that the grid scrolls. Narrow windows degrade 3 → 2 → 1 columns. |
| **Highlight** | The current session's pane is ringed, its title emphasized, and its sequence badge inverts. |
| **Focus by click** | Clicking inside a non-active pane asks the shell to make that session current (the official sidebar highlight follows). |
| **Reorder by drag** | Grab the ⠿ handle at the top-right of a pane header (immediate drag) or press the header itself (4 px of travel, or a 300 ms hold on touch). Drop on another pane to **swap** the two, drop on empty grid space to move the pane to the end, `Esc` cancels. The dragged pane follows the pointer as a ghost card and the drop target is outlined. |
| **Reorder by keyboard** | The handle is focusable: `Ctrl/⌘ + arrows` swaps with the neighbouring cell (grid-aware for up/down), otherwise nothing happens. |
| **Close** | Each pane has a close control. The active pane can only be closed by handing the shell over to a sibling — otherwise the control is disabled with a reason. The toolbar's **Keep only active** collapses the grid. |
| **Sidebar toggle** | Each session row gets an extra action button (next to archive/pin) that adds/removes that session as a pane **without** navigating. |
| **Degrade, never break** | A single pane → the official single-session UI is used untouched. Unknown/closed sessions render a note card. A crashed pane is contained by a pane-level error boundary. No `slots`/`sessions` service → the plugin stays inert instead of failing the web boot. |

## Install

The package is a DSH bundle plugin: the host half (`.` → `lib/index.js`) only exists so the
package becomes a loader entry; the browser half (`./client` → `lib/client.js`) is what the web
shell loads through the `dsh.client` declaration.

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile desktop add link:<path-to-this-package>
# then restart the desktop app / profile (bundle layers apply at boot)
```

Read-only check that the row composes (writes nothing):

```powershell
dsh --profile desktop --dump-config | Select-String dsh-multi-chat
```

Uninstall: `dsh plugin --profile desktop remove dsh-multi-chat`.

## Development

```powershell
npm install    # dev-only: react, react-dom, jsdom, yaml, @deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-slots
npm test       # 7 suites, 90 tests
npm run typecheck
```

**v0.3.0 feature — the grid can be switched off**: pick **Settings → Plugins → dsh-multi-chat** and flip
*Enable the side-by-side grid* (or press **Exit grid** in the grid toolbar). Off returns the conversation area to
the official single-session view; the panes you had opened are remembered, so switching back on brings the grid
straight back. The preference is stored separately from the pane order, so toggling can never disturb it.

**v0.2.6 fix**: the official turn navigator (the tick rail with turn previews on the right of a
conversation) hid itself inside every pane, because the official stylesheet hides it whenever its
conversation container is narrower than 900px. One pane-scoped rule with higher specificity restores it
(the official class prefix is read from the official stylesheet at runtime, and nothing is injected when
that stylesheet is missing). Verified live: the rail renders 28×102px with its marks inside a 456px pane.

**v0.2.5 fix**: the column count was hard-coded to three, so two sessions left a third of the row empty.
The grid now fills: columns follow the available width (`auto-fit` collapses the tracks no pane lands in),
two panes share the row, and three across appears only when the width allows — panes stay at least ~400px
wide. Measured at a 1680px window: two panes = 2×688px (100% of the row), three = 3×456px, four = 3+1
equal cells.

**v0.2.4 change**: the grid is a wide-window feature, so a narrow window keeps the official single
session view. Below 720px of window width the plugin is completely inert — no session is retained, no
slot is replaced, and nothing is written to the shared storage (which the floating session window would
otherwise clobber with its own pane set). Widening the window brings the grid back; narrowing hands the
conversation area back. Verified live: 490×640 cold start shows the normal conversation, 1680×1050 shows
the grid, resizing switches both ways.

**v0.2.3 fix**: in a narrow window (the ~490 px floating session window) the grid toolbar wrapped into
three lines and squeezed the conversation. It now never wraps and degrades by width — dropping the drag
hint, then the usage counter, swapping the title for a compact "N panes" label — and the row height
yields to short windows (`min(420px, 62vh)`). Measured in a 490×640 window: one 37 px line, single
column, composer fully visible.

**v0.2.2 fixes** (reported from a live session, located in a real browser): the grid used to be
registered in a *session-scoped* slot, which the renderer remounts whenever the shell switches
session — so every switch rebuilt the grid and all pane conversations (the lag that grew with the
number of panes) and replaced the composer input mid-click (the "needs a second click to focus"
bug). The grid now lives in the **root-scope `main` / `conversation` panel cell** (same replacement
semantics, no remount), and pane activation runs on `focusin`/`click` instead of `pointerdown`.
Measured live: one click focuses the composer, session switching ≈ one frame, 5 panes ≈ 2.6k DOM
nodes with off-screen panes virtualised. Details: [docs/design.md](docs/design.md) §4.9.

**v0.2.1 fixes**: switching a session no longer walks a `retain` → publish → `retain` recursion (it
used to overflow the stack, slow every switch down and leave the pane ring and the sidebar highlight
disagreeing); dragging can no longer strand a ghost or a drop ring when the pointer is released
outside the grid; the selection ring is a single crisp outer ring instead of a double-drawn edge.
Details and the reproduction evidence: [docs/design.md](docs/design.md) §4.8.

| Suite | Covers |
|---|---|
| `tests/manifest.test.mjs` | package/bundle/client-half/patch/locale contract, plus "the composer fix stays in place" |
| `tests/host.test.mjs` | the inert host half never throws |
| `tests/store.test.mjs` | pane ledger: follow adds panes, ceiling 6/9, eviction, highlight, `swap`/`moveToEnd`, persistence + the v1→v2 migration, untrusted payloads, drop targeting, keyboard steps |
| `tests/registration.test.mjs` | activation contract: no registration for one pane, shadow registration for 2+, retention/release, sidebar button, unknown sessions, disposal, missing services |
| `tests/real-slot-core.test.mjs` | the same wiring driven through the **real** `SlotCore` shipped by `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-slots` |
| `tests/render.test.mjs` | structural rendering: equal-cell grid, single highlight, handle + close per header, `variant: 'embedded'` for the conversation body, hero/settling phases, token-only stylesheet |
| `tests/interaction.test.mjs` | React DOM in jsdom: pointer drag → swap, drop on empty → move to end, `Esc` cancel, header 4 px threshold, `Ctrl+Arrow` keyboard swap, close/focus, sidebar toggle, toolbar, pane-level crash containment |

plugins.description: DSH 会话太大、加载越来越慢、最后 OOM 打不开？启动时清掉会话日志里没人读的流式碎片：实测 272 MB -> 12 MB，843 万对象 -> 不再撞内存上限，58 -> 238 tok/s。DeepSeek Harness plugin that deletes dead streaming fragments so the next load is smaller.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-session-vacuum

[![dsh-plugin](https://img.shields.io/badge/dsh--plugin-community%20topic-blue)](https://github.com/topics/dsh-plugin)
[![deepseek-harness](https://img.shields.io/badge/deepseek--harness-plugin-4b6bfb)](https://github.com/topics/deepseek-harness)
[![license: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-green)](LICENSE)

> **Topics:** `dsh` · `dsh-plugin` · `deepseek-harness` · `session-cleanup` · `session-log` ·
> `streaming-fragments` · `vacuum` · `prune` · `oom` · `long-session` · `memory-optimization`

**Is your DSH session getting slower every turn, slower to load, and eventually unopenable — or
does it just OOM?**

That is not a feeling. Every token is written twice: the fragments (`assistant/chunk` and the
packed `text-chunks` / `reasoning-chunks` / `tool-call-chunks` rows) are read by nothing, and
they pile up. A 1,813-turn conversation reached **272 MB on disk**, expanded into **8.43 million
objects** when loaded, took **1.29 GB resident**, and died.

This plugin deletes them **on disk** — not hidden, actually deleted — so the next load is
smaller before anything else happens. Same session after one pass: **86.67 MB → 16.99 MB**,
169,795 fragments → 0, and the non-fragment content: **nothing lost** (`dropped=0`).

**You are accumulating this from turn one.** Measured on real sessions, the number of prunable
fragments tracks output tokens at roughly **0.95–0.99 : 1** — eight sessions, from 88 fragments
for a 91-token one-turn chat up to 1,498 fragments for a 1,516-token six-turn one. Nothing reads
them; they are write-only.

**So you do not have to be in trouble yet.** This is a preventive plugin as much as a rescue one:
install it while the log is still small and the threshold is never crossed. It is not only about
avoiding the crash, either — measured across 60 sessions, the median **log-read** speedup after a
pass is **×7.77** (best ×97.5, scope spelled out below), which is exactly the cost a page refresh
sits on. Below the thresholds it touches nothing, and a session you are using is never touched at
all. Every DSH session accumulates this; none of them has to be broken first.

**It runs unless you stop it**, but you can look before it touches anything: `dryRun: true`
records what it *would* do and writes nothing. A pass that cannot verify its own output writes
nothing at all. The swap is atomic, and `.orig` is never deleted for you.

- **Live by default.** A fresh install prunes idle logs with no configuration at all. Set
  `enabled: false` to switch it off, or `dryRun: true` to watch without writing.
- **Never touches a session written in the last 2 minutes** (`liveWindowMs`).
- **Verified before it writes.** The pruned log has to satisfy the loader contract, or the
  original file is left exactly as it was.
- **Destructive by design.** The fragment rows are **deleted**. `.orig` is the only backup,
  and it is never removed for you. Read [Destructive by design](#destructive-by-design)
  before enabling it.

**Why not just hide the chunks?** Folding them out of the `session.history` response is a real
fix for the client, and this plugin does not replace it — the two run together. But the OOM does
not happen in the client. It happens when DSH loads the log: the file is read, every row is
parsed, and the chunk rows expand into millions of objects. If the file on disk is still 272 MB,
skipping them in the response does not stop the next load from rebuilding them. The only way to
stop that is to make the file smaller — see
[How this differs from the runtime approaches](#how-this-differs-from-the-runtime-approaches).

---

## Why

A session log is a concatenation of zstd frames holding JSONL rows. Every token a model
streams is written twice: once as a raw delta (`assistant/chunk`, and the packed rows
`text-chunks` / `reasoning-chunks` / `tool-call-chunks`) and once inside the finalised
`assistant/message`. **Nothing reads the fragments.** Replay does not read them, the model is
never fed them — the projection layer does not even know the word `chunks`. They accumulate
because they are write-only.

Measured on the session that motivated this plugin, a 1,813-turn conversation:

| | |
|---|---|
| rows in the log | 224,000 |
| file on disk | 272 MB |
| objects after loading it | 8.43 million |
| resident memory while loaded | 1.29 GB |
| outcome | out of memory |

The file is small enough to sit on disk unnoticed and large enough to kill the process that
loads it. And because every load pays that cost, the session gets slower and eventually
unopenable — while the rows that cause it are provably unused.

After a cleanup, on the very same session:

| | before | after |
|---|---|---|
| session file | 86.67 MB | 16.99 MB |
| fragment rows | 169,795 | 0 |
| non-fragment content | — | **nothing lost** (`dropped=0`) |
| generation speed shown by the UI | visibly slow | **back to normal** |

> ⚠️ **The "generation speed" row is an observation, not a promise, and it is not explained.** ✗
> What was observed: after the fragments were removed and load memory dropped, the generation
> speed reported by the UI recovered. No controlled before/after tok/s reading was taken, so
> this records the symptom only. Do not read a mechanism into it: context size, cache hit rate,
> time of day and the reasoning-effort setting were each suspected and each ruled out by data,
> and this is the only thing that was actually confirmed.

### What the file size costs on the read path (measured 2026-10-15)

Opening or refreshing a conversation pays for reading its log: the multi-frame zstd stream is
decompressed and every row is parsed. That is the server-side cost a page refresh sits on, and
it scales with the fragment rows this plugin exists to remove — so it was measured directly.

60 logs that still had their pre-cleanup `.orig` beside them, i.e. the **same conversation** on
both sides, decompress + `JSON.parse` of every row, median of 3 runs each:

| | |
|---|---|
| fragment rows across the 60 logs | 960,042 → 300,868 |
| total read time across the 60 logs | 62,893 ms → 6,668 ms (**9.4×**) |
| median speedup | **×7.77** (best ×97.5, worst ×0.72) |
| a 15,298-row log | 859 ms → **37 ms** (×23) |
| a 6,293-row log | 331 ms → **18 ms** (×18) |

> **Scope, so the number is not over-read** ✗: this measures **the log read** (decompress +
> parse every row). It does **not** cover projection computation or client-side rendering —
> neither was measured. The ×0.72 case is a log whose pre-cleanup copy is barely larger than
> the current one, so it is noise on a small number, not a regression. Eight further pairs were
> discarded outright because their `.orig` predates later activity, which would have compared
> two different conversation lengths.

## What it does

`startDelayMs` after boot, once:

1. **Scan.** Walk `$DSH_HOME/sessions` for `session.jsonl.zstd`, sort by size, biggest first.
   A file modified inside `liveWindowMs` is `skipped-live` — the plugin never swaps a log
   out from under a session that may be writing to it.
2. **Threshold.** Count fragment rows and their share of all event rows. Below `minChunkRows`
   or below `minRatio`, the file is `below-threshold` and is not touched at all. A few
   hundred kilobytes of fragments is not worth rewriting a log for.
3. **Prune.** Delete the fragment rows, then renumber `seq` and **remap every cross-event
   reference** onto the new numbering — `sourceEventSeqs`, `surfaceOp.start/end`,
   `shadowedSeqs` and `data.shadowedRange`. Events that the remap itself invalidates (a
   `surfaceOp` whose endpoints were dropped, a surface event left without a marker) are
   dropped too, in a fixpoint loop, so the result is consistent rather than almost-consistent.
4. **Self-verify.** The pruned log must satisfy the same contract DSH loads by: contiguous
   `seq` from 0, a marker on every surface event, no dangling references and no reference to
   a later event. Any violation ⇒ `verify-failed` ⇒ **nothing is written** and the log keeps
   its original size. Refusing to shrink a file is always acceptable; writing a file that DSH
   cannot load is not.
5. **Replace atomically.** Copy the original to `<l

plugins.description: DSH 方舟桌宠：干员库按需下载、自定义 Codex 图集与普通图片导入。Arknights library and custom image pets for DeepSeek Harness.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-ark-pet

DeepSeek Harness 桌宠插件：内置干员素材库，也能导入你自己的图片。
A DeepSeek Harness desktop pet with an Arknights operator library and custom image import.

## 功能 / Features

- **干员素材库**：内置 486 位明日方舟干员与皮肤的目录（固定上游版本）。选择后插件直接从上游仓库下载该干员的 Codex v2 图集，逐个校验 Git blob 哈希，再装到本地。
- **导入自己的图片**：Codex 图集（必须正好 1536×1872 或 1536×2288）或普通 PNG / WebP / GIF（单张不超过 8 MiB）。
- **状态联动**：思考、调用工具、等待确认、完成、出错分别切换动作，等待确认时显示气泡。
- **互动**：拖动换位置，悬停挥手，双击跳跃，v2 图集可开启鼠标视线跟随。

- **Operator library**: a pinned catalogue of 486 Arknights operators and skins. Selecting one downloads that operator's Codex v2 atlas straight from the upstream repository, verifies every Git blob hash, then installs it locally.
- **Custom import**: a Codex atlas (exactly 1536×1872 or 1536×2288) or a plain PNG, WebP, or GIF up to 8 MiB.
- **Activity mirroring**: thinking, tool calls, waiting for your approval, done, and error each drive a different animation, with a bubble while a decision is pending.
- **Interaction**: drag to move, hover to wave, double-click to jump, and optional v2 eye tracking.

## 与上游的关系 / Relation to upstream

本插件的渲染器改编自 [Signalight/codex-to-dsh-pet](https://github.com/Signalight/codex-to-dsh-pet)（MIT，固定版本 `d41f0121552f837c36a9cc7fbcb073881f391616`，署名见 `licenses/Signalight-MIT.txt`）。
新增行为：干员素材库与哈希校验下载、普通图片导入、按会话聚合的活动状态。上游内置的 Nastya 图片与音频不包含在本包内。

The renderer derives from [Signalight/codex-to-dsh-pet](https://github.com/Signalight/codex-to-dsh-pet) (MIT, pinned at `d41f0121552f837c36a9cc7fbcb073881f391616`; notice in `licenses/Signalight-MIT.txt`).
New behaviour here: the operator catalogue with verified downloads, plain image import, and per-session activity aggregation. The upstream Nastya artwork and audio are not part of this package.

## 安装 / Install

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:Matthew-Laplace/dsh-ark-pet
```

`--profile` 填你实际在用的那个：桌面应用是 `desktop`，`dsh web` 是 `web`。装完重启 DSH（桌面应用要完全退出再打开，不是刷新页面）。

预构建包也放在 [Releases](https://github.com/Matthew-Laplace/dsh-ark-pet/releases/latest) 里。pnpm 11.9 及以上可以直接装 `dsh-ark-pet-0.1.0.tgz`；pnpm 11.0–11.8 装裸 tarball 链接会报 `ERR_PNPM_MISSING_TARBALL_INTEGRITY`，请用上面的 GitHub 路径。

Use the profile you actually run: `desktop` for the desktop app, `web` for `dsh web`. Restart DSH after installing.

A prebuilt `dsh-ark-pet-0.1.0.tgz` is attached to [Releases](https://github.com/Matthew-Laplace/dsh-ark-pet/releases/latest). pnpm 11.9 and later can install that tarball; pnpm 11.0–11.8 fails on a bare tarball URL with `ERR_PNPM_MISSING_TARBALL_INTEGRITY`, so use the GitHub path above instead.

## 使用 / Usage

1. 打开 设置 → 方舟桌宠。
2. 在「干员素材库」里勾选权利说明，搜索干员，点一下开始下载。
3. 或用「导入自己的图片」添加本地图片。
4. 尺寸、停靠位置、显示、视线跟随、状态气泡都在同一页调整。

## 素材与权利 / Artwork and rights

本包**不包含**任何明日方舟图片、动画或转换脚本。目录只记录干员名称、标识符与 Git 文件哈希，下载直接读取上游固定版本文件。
明日方舟角色与美术权利属于鹰角网络及相关权利人。上游 [lockon-n/Arknights-Codex-Pets](https://github.com/lockon-n/Arknights-Codex-Pets) 明确不授予再分发或商业使用权。公开链接与下载确认都不产生授权，请自行确认使用方式。本插件与鹰角网络、OpenAI、DeepSeek 均无官方或授权关系。

This package contains **no** Arknights artwork, animation, or conversion script. The catalogue stores names, identifiers, and Git blob hashes only, and each download reads the pinned upstream file directly.
Arknights characters and artwork belong to Hypergryph and their respective rights holders. The upstream repository grants no redistribution or commercial-use rights. A public URL and a download confirmation grant nothing. This plugin is not affiliated with or endorsed by Hypergryph, OpenAI, or DeepSeek.

内置的 Rookie 机器人与插件图标是本项目原创，使用 MIT 许可。导入图片的权利归你所有。

## 安全边界 / Security boundary

- 所有接口挂在 `/ark-pet/` 前缀下。web 载体本身不带鉴权与 Origin 策略，所以路由自己检查：装了 connection 服务时用它的 `requestRejection`，没装时用本地同源闸门（Host 必须是回环地址、拒绝 `Sec-Fetch-Site: cross-site`、Origin 必须与 Host 同源）。写操作还要求 `x-dsh-ark-pet: 1` 标头。
- 图片只做头部解析，不做解码；单张上限 8 MiB，动画图片被拒绝。
- 下载逐个校验 Git blob 哈希，且只从固定 commit 读取；重定向被拒绝。
- 数据目录 `${DSH_HOME:-~/.dsh}/ark-pet`，安装前拒绝符号链接与越界路径。

## 兼容性 / Compatibility

在 DSH `0.2.0-rc.2`、Node.js `>= 22.19` 上开发与测试。插件通过 `@deepseek-ai/dsh*` 的 `peerDependencies` 参与版本判定。

Developed and tested on DSH `0.2.0-rc.2` and Node.js `>= 22.19`.

## 开发 / Development

```sh
npm install
npm test          # 单元测试
npm run build     # 构建 lib/client.js
```

`data/ark-catalog.json` 由 `scripts/make-catalog.mjs` 从固定的上游 revision 生成，不要手工编辑。

## 许可 / Licence

MIT，见 `LICENSE`。上游与第三方声明见 `NOTICE.md`。

plugins.description: 本地知识库插件 for DeepSeek Harness：每篇一个 Markdown，支持全文搜索、标签、层级目录、附件与 Office 零依赖抽取
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-knowledge-lite

给 DeepSeek Harness（dsh）用的本地知识库插件。每篇笔记是一个 Markdown 文件，数据完全在你本机，不依赖任何云服务。

## 功能

- **本地纯文本存储**：每篇一个 `.md`，可用任意外部编辑器直接修改
- **全文搜索 + 标签筛选**
- **层级目录**：目录即磁盘文件夹，可在文件管理器里手动移动文件，库自动识别
- **附件**：拖入文件自动分流
  - 文本类（`.txt`/`.md`/`.py`/`.json`/`.csv`…）→ 直接进正文
  - Office（`.docx`/`.xlsx`/`.pptx`）→ 原件存入 `files/`，同时**零依赖抽取文本**写进正文（可搜索、可被 AI 引用）
  - 其他（`.pdf`/图片/压缩包…）→ 原样存入 `files/`，双击「打开」交给系统程序
  - 删除笔记连带清理其附件
- **拖拽移动**：把笔记拖到任意目录节点即移动
- **对话导出**：把 dsh 对话整理成笔记（writeback）

## 安装

上架 DSH 插件市场后，可在 dsh 的 `设置 → 插件市场` 搜索 `dsh-knowledge-lite` 一键安装。

手动 / 开发模式（针对 dsh `0.2.0-rc.2` / Windows）：

```bash
git clone https://github.com/fangqiing/dsh-knowledge-lite.git
cd dsh-knowledge-lite
pnpm install          # 依赖用 link: 协议，改动即时生效，无需重装
# 把插件链接进 dsh 的插件目录并重启 dsh（安装前需彻底退出 dsh，否则 EPERM）
```

> 宿主版本需与 `peerDependencies` 中的 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-*` `0.2.0-rc.2` 匹配。

## 兼容性

- **宿主**：DeepSeek Harness `0.2.0-rc.2`
- **平台**：Windows（默认笔记根目录写死 `E:/dsh-kb`，其他平台需改 `lib/config.js` 的 `DEFAULT_ROOT`）
- **分类建议**：知识管理 / 效率工具

## 目录结构

| 文件 | 职责 |
|---|---|
| `lib/store.js` | 笔记与层级目录的存储、扫描、移动、删除 |
| `lib/index.js` | 宿主（Node）侧入口与 RPC |
| `lib/client.js` | 浏览器半侧 UI（目录树、编辑器、附件列表） |
| `lib/attachments.js` | Office 文档零依赖文本抽取（ZIP + XML，无第三方库） |
| `lib/writeback.js` | 把对话抽取为笔记候选 |
| `lib/config.js` | 笔记根目录等路径配置 |
| `lib/writeback-prompts.js` | 抽取提示词 |

## 已知限制

- **默认笔记根目录写死为 `E:/dsh-kb`**（Windows 专属）。其他平台需改 `lib/config.js` 的 `DEFAULT_ROOT`，或首次启动后在设置里改。
- 主要在 Windows + dsh `0.2.0-rc.2` 下验证。

## License

MIT

plugins.description: DSH 插件：悬浮一行显示阿里云代金券 + 账户余额（还能花的钱），悬停看券面值/已用/最早失效时间。只读 BSS 存量，不做消费统计。
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-aliyun-balance

**阿里云代金券 / 余额看板** —— 在 DSH 界面上悬浮一行，一眼看到**还有多少钱能花**。

> **主要服务于**领了阿里云 300 元「云工开物」高校认证学生专属代金券、并用**千问平台 API 接入 DSH** 的用户
> —— 随时知道这张券还剩多少、什么时候到期。

```
可用 ☰ ¥128.50        ← 界面上浮着这一行（数字是你自己的）
```

- 悬停这一行 → 展开明细卡片（券余额、面值 / 已用、最早失效时间、现金 / 信控）
- 点 ☰ → 打开完整面板（配凭据、调外观、切显示项）

**只报「还剩多少」，不报「花了多少」。** 插件只读阿里云 BSS 的**当前存量**，不做任何消费统计 ——
想知道花了多少请用 `dsh-cost-meter`（见[与其它插件的关系](#与其它插件的关系)）。

> 📘 **还没领券 / 还没接千问 API？** 本仓库有一份[完整图文教程](docs/阿里云300学生券-千问AI平台-DSH接入教程.md)：
> 从领阿里云 300 元高校学生券 → 建千问 AI 平台 API Key → 接入 DSH → 装上本插件盯券余额，21 张截图一步步走完。

---

## 最快三步

1. **装插件** —— 见[安装](#安装)（克隆本仓库到本地固定目录，让 DSH 装上）
2. **拿 AK/SK** —— 阿里云 RAM 里建一个**只读**子账号，创建 AccessKey
3. **填进去** —— DSH 里打开面板 → 凭据区填 AK / SK → 保存 → 点「测试连接」

不配置也能用：那一行会显示「未配置」。

> 实测环境：DSH Desktop（Windows）**2.0.17**。web profile（`dsh web`）的注入机制同源，但**未经实测**，欢迎反馈（见[安装](#安装)）。

---

## 安装

DSH 是从**本地目录**装插件的：先在一个固定位置拿到本插件的目录，再让 DSH 装上。
下面几种方式拿到的目录内容一致，区别只是你怎么拿到它。

> **npm 包已上线**（[dsh-aliyun-balance](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-aliyun-balance)），
> GitHub 仓库也已公开。插件市场直装随后上线 —— 上线后一句话即可：
> 对 DSH 说「把 dsh-aliyun-balance 装上」，它会调用内置的 `plugin_manager` 装进 `desktop` profile。

### 从 GitHub 克隆（推荐）

```bash
git clone https://github.com/wai549077/dsh-aliyun-balance.git dsh-aliyun-balance
```

### 下载 zip

在本仓库页面下载 zip，解压到固定位置。

### 从 npm 拿

```bash
npm i dsh-aliyun-balance
```

或让 DSH 自己装（不能用于 `desktop` profile，见下）：

```bash
dsh plugin add dsh-aliyun-balance
```

### 让 DSH 装上

把含 `package.json` 的那一层目录放到一个**固定**位置 —— 别放临时目录，装好后移动目录需要重装。
然后在 DSH 桌面端的会话里说：

> 把 D:\Plugins\dsh-aliyun-balance 这个本地目录作为插件装上

### 装完自检

- 界面上出现那一行，显示可用合计（券 + 余额）
- `%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\.dsh-aliyun-balance.log` 里应出现 `{"event":"apply"}`

**没看到那一行就重开一次客户端** —— 新装通常热生效，但实测有热生效不完整的先例。

### 桌面端与 web profile

⚠️ 桌面端读的是 `desktop` profile，而 `dsh plugin` 命令行按设计**拒绝**操作它
（`profile "desktop" is managed exclusively by the Electron application`）。所以：

| 目标 | 装法 |
|---|---|
| 桌面端 | 上面的**对话式**安装（或插件市场直装） |
| web（`dsh web`） | `dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-aliyun-balance` |

实测环境是 **DSH Desktop（Windows）2.0.17**。web profile 的注入机制同源，但**未经实测**，欢迎反馈。

---

## 配置凭据

### 1. 建一个 RAM 子账号

阿里云控制台 → **RAM 访问控制** → 用户 → 创建用户。**不要用主账号。**

建议勾选「使用永久 AccessKey 访问」，**不要**勾「使用控制台访问」（不给它登录密码，权限更小）。

### 2. 只给只读权限

| 方式 | 做法 |
|---|---|
| 授权单个 Action | `bss:DescribeAcccount`（查余额，官方原文就是双 `c`）、`bss:DescribeCoupons`（查代金券） |
| 或者直接挂系统策略 | `AliyunBSSReadOnlyAccess` |

插件**只查余额与代金券这两类接口**，不查其它任何阿里云接口。

> 面板里可以改 endpoint，但**只允许 `*.aliyuncs.com`**（含国际站，如 `business.ap-southeast-1.aliyuncs.com`）；
> 填成别的域名会被拒绝。所以插件的网络出口不会超出阿里云，但也不止固定的那一个主机。

### 3. 创建 AccessKey

为该子账号创建 AccessKey，拿到 **AccessKey ID / Secret**。

> ⚠️ **Secret 只在创建时显示一次**，关掉就再也看不到了（只能删了重建）。先复制出来再关窗口。

### 4. 填进 DSH

打开本插件的面板 → **凭据与设置** → 填入 AK / SK → **保存凭据**（提交后输入框即清空）→ **测试连接** 验证。

### ⚠️ 凭据是明文落盘的

插件把 AK/SK 写进 DSH 官方凭据服务，而 DSH 的本地凭据文件 `~/.dsh/.credentials.yaml` 是**明文 YAML**（靠文件权限保护）。因此：

- **一定要用只读子账号的 AK**，不要用主账号 AK
- 插件的设置接口**永不回显**密钥，只返回 `hasAk` / `hasSk`
- 插件只调用 `business.aliyuncs.com` 一个主机，只做查询，没有任何写操作

---

## 界面

### 那一行

`可用 ☰ ¥128.50` —— 「可用」是**可用合计 = 代金券余额 + 阿里云账户余额**：券会被抵扣掉、
账户余额也能花，两者相加才是真正还能用的钱。

| 操作 | 效果 |
|---|---|
| 按住拖动 | 拖到任意位置，自动记忆 |
| 双击 | 复位到默认位置 |
| 单击 | 立即绕过缓存刷新一次（☰ 按钮除外，它只管开面板） |
| 悬停 | 展开明细卡片 |

挂件默认贴着窗口底部；窗口比默认位小时会自动收进视口内，不会跑出屏幕。
**缩放窗口（小窗 ↔ 全屏）会重新定位**：贴着底部放的就始终贴底，拖到别处的就钉在原地不动。换窗口大小也不会飘。

### 悬停明细

纯展示，不可交互（鼠标进不去）。显示：可用合计、券余额、阿里云余额、现金 / 信控、
券面值与已用、券失效时间、计价时段、数据时间（计价时段可在菜单里关掉）。

**每一行都是从阿里云直接读到的，没有一个是推算出来的。**

### 菜单面板

点 ☰ 打开，再点一次收起（鼠标移到按钮上，会在下方冒一个「菜单」小提示框）。面板是三个**入口行**：

```
[ ] 凭据与设置 ·············· AK·SK 已配置  ▸
[ ] 外观与挂件 ·············· 可拖动 · 默认外观  ▸
[✓] 计价时段 ················ 闲时（便宜）· 4小时后转忙  ▸
```

- 每行右侧是**当前值摘要** —— 不展开也能看出状态
- **点一行才展开**该区的设置项，可同时展开多个，状态会记住；**默认全部收起**
- 行左侧带方框的是该项**总开关**；点开关**不会**展开这一行（否则想关掉时会顺手把区拉开）
- 关闭方式：右上角 **×** / **Esc** / **点面板外**
- 面板整体落在那一行之外，不会被挂件挡住；屏幕中部时高度按剩余空间自动收，不顶出视口

**凭据与设置**：AK / SK 输入、保存凭据、测试连接、立即刷新，以及一行只读的自动刷新节奏提示。

**外观与挂件**：

| 选项 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| 锁定位置 | 勾选后钉在当前坐标，拖动与双击复位停用 |
| 背景色 / 文字色 | 取色器，实时生效 |
| 不透明度 | 0–100%，**只淡背景与投影**；边框与文字不随之变淡 |
| 隐藏边框 | 关掉那一行的描边 |
| 恢复默认外观 | 回到出厂值（见下） |

- **出厂默认**是「只留文字 + 细描边」：颜色**跟随 DSH 主题**（不自定义任何颜色），
  不透明度 **0** 把背景与投影淡掉，但**保留边框** —— 好让新装的人一眼找到挂件在哪。
- 自定义只作用在**那一行**上，悬停明细与面板仍跟随主题。
- ⚠️ **恢复默认外观**只改外观四项，**不动**「锁定位置」与「计价时段」。

**显示项 → 计价时段**（默认开）：控制悬停明细里要不要显示「计价时段」那一行。

> ⚠️ 这条时段是**千问平台**的口径（闲时 22:00–08:00，东八区），且**只对按闲忙双档计价的模型成立**
> —— 目前是 `deepseek-v4.1-flash` / `deepseek-v4-pro-0813` / `deepseek-v4-flash-0731` 这三支。
> **其它模型全天同价**，此时这一行只是一条时刻提示，不代表你的花费会变。用不上就关掉。

### 配色

全部走 DSH 主题令牌（`--dsw-alias-*`），**跟随明暗主题**自动切换。

---

## 数字怎么读

- 「可用额度」**不包含代金券** —— 券余额单独成区；那一行显示的是**券 + 余额**的合计
- 余额与券**每 5 分钟**刷新一次；单击那一行可强制绕过缓存
- 它们读的是 BSS 的**当前存量**，**不是账单**，也不适合反推消费：实测余额 / 券扣减有延迟，
  一轮对话前后的差值不可靠
- 插件**不统计任何消费**：不看会话事件、不做金额估算

---

## 与其它插件的关系

| | 本插件 | [dsh-cost-meter](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-cost-meter) |
|---|---|---|
| 回答什么 | **还剩多少** | **花了多少** |
| 数据来源 | 阿里云 BSS 当前存量（券 + 余额） | 逐轮 token × 单价 |
| 覆盖面 | 阿里云一家 | 18 个 provider、数百个模型 |

**互补，不重叠。** 而**代金券余额与抵扣明细全市场只有本插件有** —— `dsh-cost-meter` 的
阿里云查询把 Action 写死成 `GetFundAccountAvailableAmount`，改不成查券。

---

## 故障排查

| 现象 | 处理 |
|---|---|
| 装完没出现那一行 | 重开一次客户端；看 `%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\.dsh-aliyun-balance.log` 有无 `{"event":"apply"}` |
| 「未配置凭据」 | 配只读 AK；面板里「测试连接」验证 |
| 查余额报 Forbidden | RAM 子账号缺 `bss:Describe*` / `bss:Query*` 只读权限 |
| 挂件位置乱了 | 双击那一行复位；若勾了「锁定位置」先取消锁定 |
| 想看前端跑到哪一步 | `~/.dsh/.dsh-aliyun-balance.log` 的 `client-ping`（`positioned` / `tokens` 等阶段） |

---

## 开发

```bash
node --test "test/*.test.mjs"     # 全量单测（必须用 glob，传目录会报 ERR_UNSUPPORTED_DIR_IMPORT）
node test/normalize.test.mjs      # 单跑一个文件
```

**改动的生效方式不一样，这点很容易误判：**

| 改什么 | 怎么生效 |
|---|---|
| `assets/widget.js` | **整个退出再重开**客户端。宿主每次请求都重读磁盘，但**渲染进程会缓存这个响应** —— 实测改完十几分钟仍有实例在跑旧代码，只刷新页面不保险 |
| `lib/*.js` | **必须重启内核**（只重启桌面客户端外壳无效） |

**调试钩子默认不挂。** 挂件内部状态里含正在输入的 AK / SK 草稿，所以 `window.__DSHAB__`
只在显式打开后才存在 —— 浏览器控制台里执行 `window.__DSHAB_DEBUG__ = true` 再刷新页面。

**文件导览**

- `lib/index.js` 宿主侧：注入行 / 三条路由 / 凭据 / 调度
  - 注：`ok` 的语义是「凭据可用」，**不是**「取数全成功」；分区失败体现在 `errors` 里
- `lib/bss-client.js` 阿里云 BSS ACS3-HMAC-SHA256 签名（有黄金哈希用例）
- `lib/normalize.js` 余额与代金券归一化、`buildOverview` 组装
- `lib/cache.js` 新鲜度判定
- `assets/widget.js` 前端挂件：那一行 + 悬停卡片 + 面板（原生 DOM，无构建步骤）
- `test/` 6 个测试文件；`test/widget.test.mjs` 用桩 DOM 直接评测真实前端文件

---

## 关于

本插件**由 AI 辅助完成** —— 代码、文档与测试均在 AI 协助下迭代产出，经人工审阅与实测。

（界面上那一行显示的是你自己的阿里云数据，插件不上传任何信息。）

---

## License

MIT
