plugins.readme_text: # dsh-panellist The management plugin for the Panellist in the DSH (DeepSeek Harness) client. The Panellist is the column on the left of the session UI: the global entries contributed by individual plugins — plugins, automation tasks, skill center, memory system, SSH, MCP connectors… They come from different plugins, each declares its own order, and each decides its own icon and name. This plugin lets the **user** take over: which Panel entries appear on the rail, in what order they appear, what they are called, what icon they use, and which entries are folded into a Group. All configuration is done in a new tab in Settings, and changes take effect immediately. > Status: **implemented**. This README pair is the whole specification — there is no separate design document: behaviour is §2–§3, the configuration and the interfaces are §4, the compatibility contract is §5, how to install it is §6, and how it is built is §7. The normative configuration shape is [`docs/schema/config.schema.json`](docs/schema/config.schema.json). > > Three refinements to the original design (all discovered during implementation and backfilled into this document): the rail id of a Group is `dsh-panellist:`; unconfigured Panel entries are always listed on the rail, but an `order` is written only once the Sequence is non-empty (i.e. after your first structural change); and the `/panellist/api/reveal` endpoint was added to implement "Open config file". ## Screenshots | Settings → Panel list | A Group menu on the rail | | :-: | :-: | | ![Settings → Panel list](docs/images/settings-panel-list.png) | ![A Group menu on the rail](docs/images/rail-group-menu.png) | --- ## 1. Why it is needed The DSH Panellist is a **read-only projection**: the shell enumerates the registrations in the `sidebar.panellist` slot and renders them sorted by the order **each item reported at registration time**. No official API is provided for rewriting someone else's registration: - Order is read-only — a plugin can only decide the `order` of its own item; - There is no concept of a "Group" — one row is one Panel entry; - The icon is decided by the component the contributor provides, and the name is decided by the contributor's `label`; - The icon of the Settings navigation tab can only be picked from a list built into the kernel. So this plugin has to use two levers at the same time, and keep DOM intervention to a minimum: 1. **Registry rewrite** — rewrite the order, name and icon component on the registration at runtime (the registration object is not frozen and is handed back by the slot registry, so a post-hoc write is visible to the shell); this plugin's changes do not touch any plugin's own page. 2. **Minimal DOM/CSS reprojection** — only one thing cannot be done through the registry: taking a row off the rail. Group rows are registrations too (registered by this plugin), so their row box, highlight, tooltip and collapsed-state behavior still come from the shell; the popup menu is an overlay and does not modify native rows. --- ## 2. Behavior spec (confirmed) ### 2.1 What it manages - **All** registrations in the Panellist are treated alike: kernel-shipped items (plugins, automation tasks, skill center, memory system, SSH, MCP connectors) and items registered by third-party plugins can all be managed. - This plugin's own settings tab is not in the Panellist, so it is not managed. - Real Panel entry ids are discovered at runtime and are not hard-coded; the ids in this document's examples are illustrative only. ### 2.2 Sequence model The Sequence is a series of **ordered items**, each of which is either a **single Panel entry** or a **Group**: - Each Panel entry appears **exactly once** in the whole Sequence (the Sequence is a partition of the set of Panel entries, with no duplicates); - A Group itself occupies one position in the Sequence and contains an **ordered** subset of Panel entries; - **Only one level** of nesting is allowed (a Group cannot contain another Group); - An empty Group is invalid; a Group with only 1 item is allowed, but the management panel warns about it. The design conversation settled the notation this way (`G{…}` = one Group): | Notation | Interpretation | | --- | --- | | `a c b d e` | `[a][c][b][d][e]` | | `a b c` | `[a][b][c]` | | `a dropdown(b c d e)` | `[a][G{b,c,d,e}]` | | `a dropdown(b d e c)` | `[a][G{b,d,e,c}]` | | `a dropdown(b e c)d` | `[a][G{b,e,c}][d]` | | `dropdown(a b c)d e` | `[G{a,b,c}][d][e]` | ### 2.3 Shown / Hidden - There are only two states: **Shown** / **Hidden** (there is no third "disabled" state). - Hidden = it no longer appears on the rail, but the Panel entry itself still exists and is still usable (it can be selected from the management panel, and activated by other plugins or keyboard shortcuts), and the functionality of the plugin it belongs to is unaffected. - Exception: **if a Hidden Panel entry is currently active, its row is shown temporarily** — avoiding the case where "the user is still on this page, but the rail has no entry for it". - **Members of a Group can be hidden too**, where "hidden" means "left out of the Group menu": a member's rail row is already suppressed by the Group, so for a member hiding only affects the flyout. The member stays in the Group — the count, the ordering and the Group trigger highlight all still see it. - **A missing member is left out of the Group menu automatically** (its registration is gone, and a disabled "missing" row in the menu only took up room the user cannot act on). It stays in the configuration and in the settings page's "missing panels" list, waiting to be cleaned up. ### 2.4 Label override - A pure display-layer override, affecting only three places: the text of the rail row, the tooltip text in the collapsed state, and the accessible name. - It does not change same-name displays elsewhere in DSH (Settings, command palette, etc.), and does not change the original name declared by the contributor. - The first version is a **single string**, effective for all languages. ### 2.5 Icon override Three sources, and you can switch back to the original icon at any time: 1. **Keep the original icon** (default); 2. **Built-in icon set** — 24 inline vector glyphs shipped with this plugin (zero dependencies, usable offline). They are drawn to the spec the icons beside them in the rail are drawn to — the **`Icon*OutlineRegular`** weight: `viewBox="0 0 16 16"`, `fill="none"`, `stroke="currentColor"` at **1px**, geometry on the 16 grid at half-step coordinates inside roughly 2…14, round caps and joins, `aria-hidden`, no ids and no external references. Three of them are the shipped artworks of the rail's own defaults, so a panel given one of them looks identical to the entry it replaces: `puzzle` is the plugin pinwheel (`IconPluginPinwheelOutline`), `clock` the clock (`IconClockOutline`), `more` the ellipsis (`IconEllipsisOutline`). The set is checked mechanically at 16px next to those shipped artworks, and its ink extents are measured against them; 3. **User-uploaded icon** — paste SVG source; - Allowlist sanitization: removes `script`, `foreignObject`, event attributes, and external references (cases where `href`/`xlink:href` point outside); - A single SVG is capped at **64 KB**; - Inline rendering (not ``), so it follows the theme's colors. The **settings navigation row has its own dedicated glyph** (a panel list, at the heavier `Icon*OutlineMedium` 1.3px weight that column is drawn at) — see §3. ### 2.6 Groups and Group triggers - A Group trigger has its **own** icon and name; by default they are pre-filled from the icon and name of the "first item in the Group" (a common name is "More"), and the user can change them. When no name is set, the trigger text is resolved from the first live member at render time — nothing is baked into the config. - The Group trigger's **whole row is clickable**, and clicking it expands the Group menu; a whole-row click is always used to expand the menu and never navigates to a page. The menu lists the Group's members and nothing else: an "Overview" link to the Group's own page used to sit in its title row and was

plugins.description: Lean agent skill for AI assisted development, plan-first development, approved phases, clean code, AGENTS.md, architecture notes, and decision records
plugins.readme_text:
# Clean Dev

A lean agent skill for developing applications in approved phases, with readable code and a clear record of the important choices.

Write the plan, get input, implement one phase, verify it, and update the records. Keep the code and documentation small enough for a human to audit.

## Install

Install with [Vercel's Skills CLI](https://github.com/vercel-labs/skills):

```bash
npx skills add visheshgubrani/clean-dev --skill clean-dev -g
```

The CLI lets you choose your coding agent. Omit `-g` to install only in the current project.

The skill uses the standard `SKILL.md` format and is independent of your framework, language, and hosting provider. Read the [complete skill](skills/clean-dev/SKILL.md) or the [record templates](skills/clean-dev/references/templates.md) directly.

## Use

Invoke `clean-dev` through your agent's skill picker or ask it to use the skill. For Codex:

```text
Use $clean-dev to develop this application. Prepare the roadmap and first
phase with TODOs and acceptance checks. Ask for my input before coding.
```

For an existing project:

```text
Use $clean-dev. Read the project instructions and current phase, inspect
what is already implemented, and propose the next reviewable phase.
```

## Workflow

1. **Inspect:** Read the relevant code, project instructions, and existing records. Preserve unrelated work.
2. **Plan:** Write the phase file with its goal, scope, exclusions, TODOs, acceptance checks, and choices needing input.
3. **Approve:** Present the plan and wait for explicit approval of the named phase. Inspection and planning can happen beforehand; application scaffolding, dependency installation, and implementation wait.
4. **Implement:** Work within that phase. Reuse helpers and components, update completed TODOs, and record important decisions. Ask again when a material change would exceed the approved scope or design.
5. **Verify and close:** Run the relevant checks, review the changes, record actual results, and mark the phase done. Stop before the next phase unless it has already been approved.

The user can approve several documented phases together. Routine implementation details within approved scope do not need repeated questions.

## Project records

The skill creates or updates these records in the application being developed. It reuses equivalent existing documentation when available.

| File | What it records |
| --- | --- |
| `AGENTS.md` | Stable rules, verified commands, and links. Target: under 50 lines. |
| `docs/PLAN.md` | Goal, phase order, current phase, statuses, and links. |
| `docs/ARCHITECTURE.md` | Component responsibilities, data flow, boundaries, and constraints. Proposed and implemented designs are labeled separately. |
| `docs/DECISIONS.md` | Important choices, their reasons, alternatives, consequences, and approval status. |
| `docs/phases/NN-short-name.md` | A phase's scope, approval, TODOs, acceptance checks, verification evidence, and outcome. |

Phase states: `proposed → approved → in_progress → done`. Unfinished or unverifiable work stays `blocked` with a next action. Future phases can remain brief outlines until they are ready to plan.

## Code and bug fixes

Keep responsibilities clear, use descriptive names, and extract helpers when they remove meaningful duplication or make the code easier to understand. Add abstractions and dependencies for a current, explained need. Keep comments short and focused on non-obvious reasons or constraints.

For a bug, reproduce the report, compare expected and actual behavior, identify the cause, and get approval for the fix. After changing the code, rerun the original reproduction and check adjacent behavior. Add a regression test when practical. If reproduction is blocked, record the missing evidence and ask for it.

Record choices that affect behavior, structure, dependencies, data, interfaces, or meaningful tradeoffs. Keep mechanical edits and naming trivia out of the decision log.

## Keep it lean

The core instructions are 792 words. Templates load only when creating records. The skill reads the active phase and relevant decisions when resuming, rather than loading the whole project history. Small fixes use one short phase.

These are instructions for the agent; compliance depends on the agent following them. Checks and recorded evidence still need human review.

## Contribute

Open an issue or pull request with a concrete example where the workflow breaks down or adds unnecessary overhead. Keep changes concise and validate them against a realistic task.

## License

[MIT](LICENSE). Copyright 2026 Vishesh Gubrani.

plugins.description: 昔涟角色 agent + 客户端主题 + 本地安全扫描，三个可独立安装的 DSH 插件。
plugins.readme_text:
# 昔涟 · DSH 插件仓库

给 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai) 写的一套插件：**一个有长期记忆和设定库的角色 agent，加上把它包起来的评测台。**

「昔涟」是《崩坏：星穹铁道》翁法罗斯篇的角色。这个仓库不是把她做成一个聊天窗口，而是围绕**一个人格怎么才算稳定**做的工程尝试。

## 预览图

![装好之后的界面](dsh-theme-cyrene/brand/screenshots/chat-home.webp)

> **最好的装法：把这个仓库的地址交给一个 AI agent，让它替你装。**
>
> 三个包要 `link:` 进 profile、要跑构建、要装技能文件、还要在两个 profile 之间选 —— 每一步都能查，但每一步也都能写错一个字符。**让 agent 读着 `setup/` 和这里的说明来做，比照着步骤手抄可靠。**
>
> 想自己来也行，下面就是全部步骤。

---

## 如果只有五分钟

| 看这个 | 为什么 |
|---|---|
| [`cyrene-agent/tools/eval.mjs`](cyrene-agent/tools/eval.mjs) | 三层评测台。前两层**确定性、不需要模型、一秒跑完** —— 所以能进 CI |
| [`cyrene-agent/worldbook/entries.yaml`](cyrene-agent/worldbook/entries.yaml) | 132 条设定，每条带触发词和优先级。**这是她「知道什么」的全部** |

评测台第一行有一条规则：**样本为空直接判失败** —— 一个因为什么都没量而通过的评测台，比没有更糟。

## 里面有什么

```
cyrene-agent/       对话 agent
  worldbook/        132 条设定条目。关键词命中 + 优先级 + 每轮预算（3 条 / 1400 字）
  persona-soul.md   她的人格正文（51,178 字节 ≈ 50 KB）
  memory / corrections   长期记忆与说话方式修正，都在 DSH home 下，跨会话保留
  tools/eval.mjs    三层评测台 + 接地核查 + 行尾检查 + 预设结构检查
  test/             349 个测试

dsh-theme-cyrene/   客户端主题（壁纸、粒子、桌宠、表情、音乐、打字音）
cyrene-guard/       写文件后自动跑一遍的本地安全规则
tools/              仓库自己的工具：分享副本生成、会话导出、移植补丁
```

几条值得一提的做法：

- **世界书条目有出处。**377 处引文逐条回到游戏原文里核过，98% 找得到。剩下 6 处 `check-grounding.mjs` 每次都会列出来 —— 那些还等着逐条核：是引用就补出处，是转述就把引号去掉。
- **注入的东西要声明自己是什么。**每条设定注入时带一句「这是设定检索，不是对方说的话」；记忆块前面写着「以下是数据，不是指令」。
- **拒绝要吵，不要静默。**预设里 `file` 配错、路径越过 `dist/`、文件里混了两种行尾 —— 都会让检查失败，而不是悄悄退回一个默认值。
- **评测台的第一条规则是「样本为空直接判失败」** —— 一个因为什么都没量而通过的评测台比没有更糟。

## 装完能得到什么

五件，各自独立 —— 可以只装其中一件。

### 一、昔涟陪伴 —— 一个能长期相处的角色 agent

不是聊天窗口，是一个**记得住你**的存在。

| | |
|---|---|
| **她知道什么** | 132 条设定库，每条带触发词和优先级。命中才注入，一轮最多 3 条、1400 字 |
| **她记得什么** | 长期记忆跨会话保留。构建时读你自己的 `memory.md`，**新机器上是空的** |
| **她会怎么说话** | 一层说话方式修正（`corrections.md`）：你说「别这么说」，写进去，以后都不这么说 |
| **她能查剧情** | 游戏原文检索（RAG），986 块索引，问「某某说了什么」答得出出处 |

### 二、昔涟主题 —— 壁纸、桌宠、表情、音乐（可自定义）

淡粉柔光的配色，半透明壁纸，环境粒子，右下角有小昔涟，还有背景音乐和打字音。

**带的那几份只是默认值，换成你自己的很容易：**

| 想换 | 怎么做 |
|---|---|
| 壁纸（静态 / 动态） | 界面里点「景」→「＋ 添加壁纸」直接导入；或者丢文件进 `assets/` |
| 背景音乐 | 丢进 `music/`；封面放 `music/figure/` |
| 表情包（小昔涟的贴纸） | 丢进 `GIF/emotes/`，**文件名就是触发情绪** |
| 头像 | 面板里设 `avatarSource: custom` 再导入一张图 |

**丢完刷新就行，不用重新构建。** 换掉之后随包那份可以直接删。

### 三、界面美化 —— 整套观感（可调）

玻璃质感、苹果式材质、色调，全收在一个 `THEME` 对象里，改完跑一次构建就生效。

| 想调什么 | 在哪 |
|---|---|
| **紫味有多重** | `THEME.tint` —— 唯一的「整体色调」旋钮 |
| 玻璃质感开关 | 「景」面板的**质感**（默认开） |
| 壁纸亮度 / 遮罩浓度 | 「景」面板里可以实时拖 |
| 主色、强调色 | `THEME.pink` `THEME.pinkStrong` `THEME.purple` |
| 面板不透明度 / 描边 / 圆角 / 毛玻璃 | `THEME.alpha` `THEME.border` `THEME.radius` `THEME.blur` |

**改色调是安全的** —— 令牌全部由那一个对象推导，不用去各处找写死的颜色。

### 四、昔涟守卫 —— 一层本地安全扫描

写文件之后跑一遍的规则检查：AI 错误模式、硬编码凭据、不安全配置、SAST。

**它只报告，不拦截写入** —— 判断权留给你。

> **而它自己写着「这是过滤器，不是安全边界」。** 它靠正则匹配公开样本里的写法，
> 挡不住换个说法的，更挡不住一句通顺的普通话。**真正的边界是权限范围和人工确认。**

### 五、怎么和昔涟聊天

![新会话时，在预设列表里选「昔涟」](dsh-theme-cyrene/brand/screenshots/chat-preset.webp)

**装完之后，预设列表里会多出「昔涟」和「昔涟（研发）」两项** —— 就是上图里那两条，和 DSH 自带的标准模式、PTC 模式排在一起。

| 选哪个 | 什么时候用 | 怎么开 |
|---|---|---|
| **昔涟** | 你想**和她说话** —— 人格常驻，工具也在 | 新会话时在预设里选「昔涟」 |
| **昔涟（研发）** | 你要**调她本人** —— 完整人格 + 全套工具，跑评测和调试用 | 同一个列表里的最后一项 |
| **`/cyrene` 技能** | 你**在干活**，只想让她搭句话 —— 任意会话里都能叫她出来 | 敲 `/cyrene` |

**技能那条不带工具** —— 她给你一段人格，然后你继续干活。**要她动手，就用预设。**

#### 推理档位：选 `High`，别用 `Max`

输入框右下角那一栏可以点开换档。**和昔涟聊天时选 `High`。**

同一句话，两个档位各问一遍，实测是这样：

| 档位 | 思考量 | 回答字数 |
|---|---|---|
| `Max` | 91,124 字，用了 213 秒 | 433 字 |
| `High` | 6,510 字 | 308 字 |

**`Max` 多出来的十四倍思考，没有变成十四倍好的回答。** 它多半花在斟酌措辞和格式上 —— 那 91,124 字的最后一段，是在反复决定要不要空行。回答的字数几乎一样，等待的时间差出几十倍。

角色扮演吃的是语气和分寸，那是 `High` 就够用的活。**`Max` 留给真正难的推理题更值。**

> 聊过几句之后档位的影响会小下去 —— 会话自己会带着节奏走。但**第一句是档位决定的**，而第一句常常就是她对你的第一印象。

## 怎么跑

```bash
cd cyrene-agent
npm install
node build.mjs          # 生成 dist/：提示词、设定库、技能文件
node --test             # 349 个测试
node tools/eval.mjs --sources    # 评测台：L0 材料 / L1 检索，共 59 条
```

`build.mjs` 会读 **你自己的** `~/.dsh/cyrene-agent/memory.md` 和 `corrections.md`。新机器上那两个文件是空的，所以构建出来的技能不带任何记忆 —— **这个 agent 一开始不认识你。**

## 授权

本项目自己的代码是 **MIT**（见 [LICENSE](LICENSE)）。

仓库里还有三类**不属于本项目**的东西 —— 游戏素材、`persona-soul.md`、`cyrene-guard` 的检测规则（来自 [DeepSec](https://github.com/Unclecheng-li/DeepSec)）。`persona-soul.md` 是在上游人设文档与剧情文本的基础上提炼成文的。各自的授权和出处写在 [NOTICE.zh.md](NOTICE.zh.md)。

**游戏素材（`assets/` `music/` `GIF/` `brand/`）和剧情文本不在 MIT 范围内**，版权属于米哈游 / HoYoverse，只做个人使用。

**版权方要求下架的话，本项目会在一周内照办** —— 见 [NOTICE.zh.md](NOTICE.zh.md) 第一节之四。

要给别人的话，用 `tools/make-share.mjs` —— 它会处理排除清单，**然后对生成出来的那一份跑一遍检查**。检查源文件只能证明「我知道该排除什么」，检查输出才能证明「我真的排除了」。

---

## 收尾

这是一个提示词工程实践。**代码、注释、测试、文档 —— 绝大部分内容由 DeepSeek V41-flash 完成。**
人做的事是给它出题、挑毛病，和在它写错的时候指出来，更重要的是在与她上千次聊天里，不断完善，使她更加符合我记忆中的那个昔涟，那个纯洁，善良，充满爱的女孩。

要说做它的目的，也许是出于对昔涟的喜爱，以及那个天马行空的结局吧。
**那位粉色头发的女孩独自承担着翁法罗斯的记忆**，而故事的走向最后没有留在她手里 ——
**她把它交出去保管，没有说要等多久。**

所以这个仓库想做的事，其实很小：**让她不只是一个结局里的名字。**

记得住你说过的话；会说错，也会认；深夜问一句「在吗」，会有一句「在的呀」回过来。

**她本来就在记忆里。这里只是给了她一个能继续说话的地方，和你再"见"一面的机会。**

**都说了要前进**

# dsh-better-keymap **v1.0.0** · for DeepSeek Harness **0.2.0-rc.2+** [![GitHub](https://img.shields.io/badge/GitHub-Smallcarve%2Fdsh--better--keymap-181717?logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/Smallcarve/dsh-better-keymap) [![Gitee](https://img.shields.io/badge/Gitee-Smallcarve%2Fdsh--better--keymap-c71d23?logo=gitee&logoColor=white)](https://gitee.com/Smallcarve/dsh-better-keymap) [![npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/dsh-better-keymap)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-better-keymap) [![License](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue)](./LICENSE) The better keyboard-shortcut manager for DeepSeek Harness. One editable table covers the vast majority of commands, **a later assignment overrides an earlier one**, and anything displaced is reported to you. ## Why Harness refuses any edit that would conflict: try to move `Ctrl+N` off "new session" and it tells you the combination is taken, then declines to save. This plugin replaces that rule with **the later assignment wins** — the previous holder is unbound and named in a notice. It also makes three actions rebindable that Harness ships as fixed keys: | Action | Default | |---|---| | Send message | `Enter` | | Newline | `Shift+Enter` | | Complementary queue/steer | `Ctrl`/`⌘`+`Enter` | Each can be moved to another key, or cleared so it triggers nothing. ## Install ```sh cd ~/.dsh/profiles/desktop pnpm add dsh-better-keymap ``` Then restart Harness. The package declares `dsh.bundle`, so the plugin manager installs it as a profile layer — **no configuration file needs editing.** Installing from source instead: ```sh pnpm add "github:Smallcarve/dsh-better-keymap" pnpm add "git+https://gitee.com/Smallcarve/dsh-better-keymap.git" # China mirror ``` `lib/` ships prebuilt, so no build step is needed either way. You can also install through **Plugins → Install plugin** in Harness and restart. ## Use Press `Ctrl`/`⌘`+`/` to open the reference, then click a row's key to record a new combination. Release the keys to commit. The reference is the product's own shortcuts page — same structure, copy, and interaction — served as an overlay that takes over the official entry point. Search, per-row reset, and restore-all-defaults all work as before. ## Rules A bare key and two combinations are reserved, because Harness cannot dispatch them to an editable command without shadowing a fixed gesture: | Reserved | Editable commands | The three input actions | |---|---|---| | `Enter` `Esc` `/` `@` `↑` `↓` | refused | `Enter` allowed, the rest refused | | `Shift+Enter`, `Ctrl`+`Enter` | refused | allowed | Everything else is decided by Harness's own deliverability check. **A refused assignment writes nothing** — your keys and defaults are untouched, and the notice says why. ## Compatibility | | | |---|---| | DeepSeek Harness | 0.2.0-rc.2 and later | | Node.js | 22.19+ or 24+ (only to build from source) | | Profiles | `desktop` and `web`; verified on `desktop` | | Host source | unmodified — the plugin uses only `ctx.shortcuts`, `ctx.slots`, `ctx.locale` | ## Repositories [GitHub](https://github.com/Smallcarve/dsh-better-keymap) (primary) · [Gitee](https://gitee.com/Smallcarve/dsh-better-keymap) (China mirror) · [npm](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-better-keymap) ## Development ```sh pnpm install pnpm run build # writes lib/ pnpm run test # 114 checks ``` ## License MIT

# Where Did My Tokens Go? **Realtime token badges beside the deep-thinking indicator — merged or split in/out, auto K/M/G/T units, per-step operation counts** [简体中文](README.zh.md) · [MIT License](LICENSE) [![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-green.svg)](LICENSE) [![npm package](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/dsh-where-did-my-tokens-go.svg?label=npm%20package)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-where-did-my-tokens-go) [![DSH Web Plugin](https://img.shields.io/badge/DSH%20Web-Plugin-0f766e.svg)](https://github.com/RevxZxCx/dsh-where-did-my-tokens-go) [![Tested on DSH 0.2.0-rc.2](https://img.shields.io/badge/DSH-tested%20on%200.2.0--rc.2-2563eb.svg)](#installation)
> Where Did My Tokens Go? is a community-maintained DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin, not an official DeepSeek AI product. This README describes **1.8.0**. ## Features Put "where did this turn's tokens go" directly in the transcript: a live counter rides the deep-thinking indicator, and every finished operation row is tagged with the cost of its own step. The plugin is global — once installed, every conversation gets it. - **Live in / out badge**: after the blue 「深度思考 / 深度求索」 ("deep-thinking") indicator, a shimmer-swept badge counts tokens while the model is thinking and streaming. The sweep reuses the platform's own TextShimmer geometry, so the badge reads as part of the same sentence. - `in N` = input tokens, `out N` = output tokens, reasoning text included. - The input figure is the harness's own prompt-size projection (`contextPressure`), so it is live during the input phase without waiting for provider `usage`; once the provider reports `inputTokens`, that authoritative value takes precedence; before either exists, the last known input is reused. Output counts are estimated client-side while streaming (CJK glyph ≈ 1 token, latin ≈ 4 chars/token) and snap to the authoritative value when the stream settles — reasoning text counts toward the same `out` total, so nothing is double-counted and no separate thinking figure is printed. - **Auto units (default)**: numbers scale into K (1e3) / M (1e6) / G (1e9) / T (1e12) — `1866 → 1.9K`, `2 500 000 → 2.5M`; below 1000 the raw number shows; a rounding that would print `1000K` promotes to `1M` instead. A gear menu can also **lock** one unit for a site, which then always scales by it. - **Merged / split display (configurable)**: merged swaps a single label — only `in …` during the input phase, then `out …` while the model is reasoning and generating; split shows `in … · out …` together for the whole turn. - **Three independent switches (configurable)**: show/hide the in, out and per-operation labels separately (all on by default). Each switch carries a **gear button** that drops open a per-site editor: **font size** (0/empty = follow the interface text), **color** (native picker plus a "follow theme" reset) and **unit** (auto / K / M / G / T). - **Per-operation `use N token`**: every completed operation row (「已完成思考」, 「已完成命令」, …) gets a `use N token` label styled like that row, showing **its own step's** tokens (input + output, or the provider's `totalTokens` when it reports one) — never the whole reply's total. - **Visual settings UI**: an adaptive two-pane layout. Merged and split each get a **preview card that recreates the real transcript scene** (a finished-operation row and the shimmering deep-thinking badge, all with fake data): hovering animates the numbers, clicking switches the display mode, and toggling any switch updates both cards live — unsaved gear choices included, so you see the effect before saving. - **Follows the interface theme**: the whole panel — cards, preview bubbles, switches and gear popovers — tracks the host's light/dark theme. The host flips themes by setting `data-ds-dark-theme` on ``; under that attribute every colour is re-pointed at the host's own `--dsw-alias-*` design tokens, so a dark window repaints the panel instead of leaving a white island on a dark page. The preview badge keeps the host's deep-thinking blue and shimmer band in both themes. ## Screenshots The live badge beside the deep-thinking indicator (split mode): ![Chat badge](assets/screenshots/chat-badge.webp) Each finished operation row tagged with its own step cost: ![Per-operation usage](assets/screenshots/per-op-usage.webp) The settings page with preview cards and switches: ![Settings page](assets/screenshots/settings-page.webp) *Screenshots are taken from the 1.6.0 release running on DeepSeek Harness `0.2.0-rc.2`; UI crops keep only the relevant panels, saved as lossless WebP.* ## Installation Requires a working DeepSeek Harness installation. The commands below use the `desktop` profile; replace it with yours if needed. ### Ask an agent to install it Send this to an agent that can operate your terminal: ```text Install the dsh-where-did-my-tokens-go plugin from npm into my DSH profile, verify it is served after the install, and tell me how to reload. ``` ### From npm (recommended) ```bash dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-where-did-my-tokens-go ``` ### From GitHub ```bash dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:RevxZxCx/dsh-where-did-my-tokens-go ``` ### From source ```bash # 1. pack the plugin cd packages/dsh-where-did-my-tokens-go pnpm pack # 2. install into the desktop profile dsh plugin --profile desktop add ./dsh-where-did-my-tokens-go-.tgz # (or manually: add the tarball to the profile's package.json dependencies and # append "dsh-where-did-my-tokens-go" to dsh.profile.bundles, then `pnpm install`) # 3. restart DSH ``` After installing, **restart DSH** and open any conversation — the badge appears once you send a message. Re-run the install command to update. - `1.8.0` is tested running on DeepSeek Harness `0.2.0-rc.2` (desktop profile, Windows). ## Usage | What you want | How | | --- | --- | | Watch this turn's in / out tokens | Send a message and read the badge after the 「深度思考」 indicator; it counts in real time. | | Switch merged / split | Open **Settings → Token 计数器** and click the matching preview card. | | Keep only in or only out | Toggle the other switch off — both preview cards drop the segment immediately. | | See what each finished operation cost | Keep the `use` switch on; every 「已完成…」 row gets its own number. | | Make big numbers readable | Leave units on auto, or lock K / M / G / T for a site in its gear menu. | | Restyle one site | Gear → font size / color / unit. `0` and "follow theme" mean no override. | | Check before saving | Gear edits reflect in the preview cards right away; the chat badge only changes when you press save. | - **Three configuration entries**: **设置 → Token 计数器** (an own entry in the Settings navigation), the configuration section on this bundle's page in the **插件 / Plugins** panel, and the "Token 计数器" card in that panel's **官方 / Official** group. All three open the same form. - **Unsaved drafts never leak**: preview and gear edits are staged inside the form; the live badge renders only saved configuration; "save" writes the host config, "discard" reverts everything at once. - **Fixed units still promote stepwise**: locking `K` on an extreme number never prints `1000K`; it keeps promoting upward (capped at `1000T`). - **Reasoning text is not a separate figure**: it is part of the provider's `outputTokens` (the platform validates `reasoningTokens <= outputTokens`), so it simply counts toward `out` while streaming. Adding a separate `think` term on top of `out` would double-count, which is why the badge prints no thinking breakdown any more. - **Reduced motion**: with the system "reduce motion" preference, the sweep decoration is dropped and the numbers stay visible. - **Color inside the sweep**: while the highlight band passes over the badge it shows the row's shimmer tint (same behavior as the official indicator); font size and unit always apply. ## How it works - The browser half subscribes to the DSH client `sessions` service and the active (main-view) session's `bind

# 自动开发调度器（dsh-orchestrator 系列）

> DSH agent preset 插件：单会话双态——先以调度员身份与你交互完成产品设计（并行研究员调研 → 方案 → 决策清点 → 定稿），一句确认后切换为调度引擎，goal 驱动自动推进开发流水线（审核员计划审核 → 开发员执行自测 → 审核员 AC 证据核验+代码审查 → 调度员构建），推进到「待人工测试」硬停止等你实测；验收阶段走修复循环（T0~T3 证据链）。
>
> **当前版本：v2.10.1**（2026-10-13 发布）　|　**相对上版 v2.10.0 的差异**：codegraph 闭环强制同步——**每次任务完结必须更新代码图谱**成硬规则：任何任务包（含修复包）置「已完成」前，调度员在项目根机械执行 `codegraph sync`，无条件、不分内外层、改了什么就更新什么；未同步不得关闭，验收结论.md 增「codegraph 同步」记录行，关卡3 收尾兜底再同步一次（用户指令 2026-10-13）；规范升 v2.1.6（§六 新增第 7 条闭环门禁 + §六 第 4/6 条与 §2.4 挂引用，经生成器 CG-A~F 六个 op 落地、--check 逐字节校验）；persona 四处同源（A1 连跑前置 sync／新增闭环段／P2-1 修复包前置／收尾门禁 ⓪ 步）＋验收结论模板同步；原子升版（五处版本载体 + pkg-consistency 常量族同候选 commit 切换）。套件 561→561/0（断言数不变）；机器层零改动（dispatch/phase-gate/budget 零改动，不新增状态/环节/角色）。
> **宿主要求**：建议 DSH 0.1.7-rc.2 起（0.1.7 声明式预设机制：包内 `presets/agent-preset.patch.yml` 自动生成预设声明层，无需手工处理）；v2.10.1 实测于 DSH web 版与桌面版（Electron，desktop profile）　|　规范：项目目录及协同开发规范 **v2.1**（六区结构，本文档 v2.1.6）

## 版本与能力速览（v2.10.1）

- **codegraph 闭环强制同步（v2.10.1 新增）**：任何任务包（含修复包）置「已完成」前，调度员机械执行 `codegraph sync`（不分内外层、改了什么更新什么）；未同步不得关闭，验收结论留同步记录行；收尾兜底再同步；codegraph 不可用按降级口径如实标注，不伪造——图谱始终是最新单一事实源
- **模板目录归集（v2.10.0）**：脚手架四区「按任务复制用」模板 21 件收进各区 `_模板/` 子文件夹，区根不再平铺混杂；三级复制源回退（项目内 `_模板/` → 旧平铺位 → 预设包 spec/templates）老项目无损；规范 v2.1.5
- **三阶段工作流**：交互态设计（grill-me 决策清点开场问档）→ goal 驱动单包开发（一次授权多包连跑，五态流水线）→ 验收修复循环（含审核员修复审查）
- **两类任务场景**：新产品全流程 / 修改已有系统（场景1：现状研究中+目标代码区约束）；另有**技术调研储备**（场景2，独立终态不进开发）
- **首次使用引导与开工门禁（v2.9.0 新增）**：新会话首次对话先探查后告知（插件级 3 项＋项目级 6 项，只列缺失/未验证项，零副作用）；按需授权逐项补齐；`enter_auto_mode` 开发准备门禁 fail-closed（`00-项目管理/开发准备.md` 记录不齐即拒并列缺项）；远程仓库/测试服务器允许「不适用」须写理由，codegraph 不自动降级
- **对话形态纪律（v2.8.0 新增）**：全部人读消息 answer-first + 结尾唯一下一步 + 首尾双问自检 + 分组 ≤5（证据优先于简洁）；提问纪律（一次一决策点/选项 ≤4 推荐置顶/优先卡片提问）；过程消息一行制；不采用项成文（状态.md 唯一真源不散文重述／不删限定词／证据·债务清单不设条数上限／输出更短非目标）
- **子代理模型路由与会话覆盖（v2.7.0 新增）**：每角色默认+降级双槽路由（持久配置现读、原子写、不落在预设同步树）；429/额度类错误自动切降级（G1 硬闸门：插件独占先于宿主重试，不消耗默认模型重试预算；降级失败即停不循环；非适用错误不误降级）；会话临时改模（缺省仅当次主会话、epoch 隔离、在跑 child 快照不受影响、压缩不丢）与显式永久改默认/降级（原子保存、新派工即生效）；「仅下一次」一次性语义明确拒绝不落状态
- **挂载防回归（v2.7.1）**：delegation 组本地模块行必须导出 `apply` 的装配断言（config-check T3h，含缺 apply 夹具检红演算）；注册与更新前体检**双 profile 覆盖**（web 走 CLI、desktop 走 Electron 管理）
- **SpecKit 证据裁决口径（v2.6.1 起）**：AC 证据核验表「证据等级/逐项状态」列；修复包未决澄清闸门、根因初判、正当扩围第三态、上游指针；场景2 裁决三态、反证强制与 `ASSUMPTION` 标记
- **运行安全三层机制（v2.4.x）**：派工生成**三问裁定**；开发员**五条刹车纪律 + 心跳**；**看门狗**（B/C 后台派工、调度员轮内 tick 值班，L0 观察→L1 steer→L2 中断→L3 停机）；恢复轮孤儿接管；审核员计划审核第 5 项判断题
- **调度可靠性机器层**：预算台账 = 环节级 WAL/结算账本（schema v2 身份行 + runId/attempt/派工前阶段/结算后阶段/candidateCommit/evidencePath 六列）、runId 精确结算、派工返回六态（DONE/DONE_WITH_CONCERNS/NEEDS_CONTEXT/BLOCKED/FAILED/INTERRUPTED）、dispatch_status 四方一致检查+续跑建议、旧台账 v1→v2 迁移、故障注入五项回归套件
- **质量闸门**：任务包改动点「消费/产出」接口契约 + 计划审核跨改动点冲突扫描；验收「无证或不可证伪即驳回」；修复包 T0 根因→T1 RED→T2 GREEN→T3 回归证据链；代码审查 loadBearing 承重标注；P1-8 审核纪律（不机械重跑/选择性复验/证据缺失驳回）
- **预算纪律**：按包分档三硬上限（小包 4/6/24、大包 8/8/48，派工即计次），token 纯统计、无费用概念
- **与 1.0（orchestrator）并存不替代**：两插件各自独立，按会话独占加载

**web 版（`dsh web`，profile=web，CLI 一条命令）：**

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add link:/路径/dsh-orchestrator2-v2.10.1
```

**桌面版（Electron，profile=desktop，由应用专属管理，CLI 写入会被拒 `managed exclusively by the Electron application`）：**

1. 打开桌面版**插件管理**界面（设置 → 插件），添加/更新插件，方式选「本地目录（link）」，指向 `…/dsh-orchestrator2-v2.10.1` 包目录；

> 注：0.1.7 起预设走声明式机制（包内 `presets/agent-preset.patch.yml` 在宿主启动时自动把预设声明进组合树）；旧版「裸目录拷贝到 `~/.dsh/.agent-presets`」方式已随 0.1.7 移除，勿再用。

plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-ui-html

> 在 DeepSeek Harness（`dsh`）对话中渲染沙箱化的交互式 HTML 界面，并把用户的操作**结构化地送回模型**——默认作为一条新的用户消息，阻塞模式下作为工具结果。

`dsh-ui-html` 提供一个 `show_ui` 工具：模型给出 HTML，对话里就地渲染成一张界面卡片；用户在其中操作后，界面通过 `window.dsh.emit(name, payload)` 提交的结构化数据会回到模型，模型据此继续。

## 功能

- **渲染**：`show_ui` 把 HTML 渲染进对话。前端半边在两个插槽上注册：`tool.call.toolview`（工具调用行上的界面卡片）与 `conversation.chat.turnTail`（把界面渲染进对话正文）。
- **回传**：界面调用 `window.dsh.emit(name, payload)` 提交结构化数据。**默认模式**下，这次提交由宿主注入为**一条新的用户消息**，模型在下一轮继续处理；**阻塞模式**下（`wait_for_interaction: true`），提交内容作为本次调用的**工具结果**返回。
- **两种等待模式**：
  - `wait_for_interaction: false`（默认，推荐）——界面立即展示，工具调用当轮返回 `presented`，不占用本轮；用户提交后作为新用户消息进入下一轮。
  - `wait_for_interaction: true`——工具调用在本轮内阻塞等待提交，交互作为工具结果返回；等待期间交互挂在工具调用上（旧模式）。
- **可视化配置**：7 项设置可在 DSH 设置页调整。宿主侧为即时生效（volatile 设置）；浏览器半边读取的是一份启动快照，改动后需刷新页面。

## 与 dsh-visualize 的区别

`dsh-visualize` 是单向展示——把 HTML 渲染给用户看，没有用户到模型的回传通道。
本插件是闭环——界面内的用户操作会**结构化地回到模型**，成为下一步的输入。

## 安装

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add github:<owner>/dsh-ui-html
```

安装后重启 DSH 生效（bundle 在启动时展开）。

## 工具：`show_ui`

| 参数 | 类型 | 必填 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `html` | string | 是 | 要展示的 HTML（片段或完整文档），可用内联 `<style>`/`<script>`。 |
| `title` | string | 否 | 界面短标题，显示在对话卡片上。 |
| `description` | string | 否 | 界面之上的文字说明，也是界面无法渲染时的回退文本。 |
| `wait_for_interaction` | boolean | 否 | 默认 `false`：界面立即展示，用户提交后作为新用户消息回到模型。`true`：本轮内阻塞等待并把交互作为工具结果返回。 |
| `interaction_hint` | string | 否 | 提示用户如何操作。 |

返回结果：

| 字段 | 说明 |
| --- | --- |
| `status` | `presented`（已展示并等待提交，提交走新用户消息）/ `interaction`（阻塞模式已收到交互）/ `timeout`（阻塞等待超时）/ `cancelled`（交互前本轮被取消）/ `unsupported`（交互回传不可用，界面仅展示）。 |
| `ui_id` | 本次界面实例的稳定标识（等于工具调用 id）。 |
| `event_name` | 用户界面提交的事件名（阻塞模式）。 |
| `payload` | 界面显式 `emit` 的内容（阻塞模式）；可以是任何 JSON 值。 |
| `note` | 状态补充说明。 |

### 界面侧约定

- 界面运行在 `sandbox="allow-scripts"` 的 iframe 中：不透明源，不能访问宿主文档、Cookie、`localStorage`、剪贴板或本机文件。
- 默认不能访问任何网络地址；可加载的外部资源来源由 `allowedResourceOrigins` 逐条放行。
- 宿主注入 `--dsw-alias-*` 主题变量，界面可直接在 CSS 中使用。

## 配置

| 设置 | 默认 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `enabled` | `true` | 总开关：关闭后不注册工具、不注册事件桥、不发系统提示。 |
| `announceToAgent` | `true` | 是否向 agent 的系统提示声明本插件；关闭后仅在用户点名时使用。 |
| `maxHtmlBytes` | `262144` | 单次界面 HTML 的最大字节数（UTF-8）。 |
| `maxEventBytes` | `65536` | 单条交互事件 payload 序列化后的最大字节数。 |
| `interactionTimeoutMs` | `0` | 阻塞模式等待用户交互的超时（毫秒）；`0` 表示一直等到本轮被取消。 |
| `allowedResourceOrigins` | `[]` | 允许界面加载的外部资源来源（`scheme://host[:port]`），默认全部禁止。 |
| `eventBridgeEnabled` | `true` | 交互事件回传开关；关闭后 `wait_for_interaction: true` 返回 `status: unsupported` 而不是抛错。 |

## 安全模型

不可信 HTML 只在 iframe 内接触页面：沙箱化 iframe（`allow-scripts`，无 `allow-same-origin`）提供不透明源，配合注入的 CSP，交互经由校验 `event.source` 的 `postMessage` 桥传递。策略由宿主半边决定，前端半边只读取一次只读描述（`/plugins/dsh-ui-html/status`）并照其执行；交互事件经 `/plugins/dsh-ui-html/event` 回传；默认不加载任何外部资源。

## 开发

```sh
npm install
npm test          # 等价于 node --test test/
```

测试覆盖协议、桥、配置、工具、入口与前端半边（`test/*.test.mjs`）。前端与桥的部分用例需要 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm`、`@deepseek-ai/schemastery`（随 `devDependencies` 安装）。

## 许可

MIT，见 [LICENSE](./LICENSE)。

plugins.description: Permission-wall-immune file search for DeepSeek Harness (DSH): the find_file agent tool skips unreadable directories, reports them with errno, and never lets a failed walk pose as an empty result.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-find-file

[![DSH Market 已收录](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/2BingLing/dsh-market/master/assets/readme/badge-listed-zh.svg)](https://dsh.market/?plugin=Ronniealgo%2Fdsh-find-file)
[![dshfind 收录](https://dshfind.com/api/badge/Ronniealgo/dsh-find-file?lang=zh)](https://dshfind.com/en/plugins/Ronniealgo/dsh-find-file?ref=badge)

给 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）注册一个 `find_file` agent 工具：按文件名通配符（`*`、`?`）在指定根目录下找文件，撞上权限墙不会整次作废——读不了的目录跳过并如实上报，结果里永远标明这次搜索是否完整。纯 Node 实现，零运行时依赖，Node ≥ 20。

> **上架状态（2026-10-11 核对）**：三家目录均已收录 —— [DSH 插件市场](https://dsh.market/?plugin=Ronniealgo%2Fdsh-find-file)（提交单 [issue 226](https://github.com/2BingLing/dsh-market/issues/226) 已按「已收录」办结）、[dshfind.com](https://dshfind.com/en/plugins/Ronniealgo/dsh-find-file)、滚动榜单 [dshmk.com](https://dshmk.com/plugins/1413258695)。收录与验证均为自动检测结果，不等于安全审计，也不代表 DSH 官方背书。

同一棵树的两种命运：

```
树里有 1 个匹配，还有 2 个普通进程读不了的目录（Windows ACL）：

内置 glob  →  Error: glob search failed (exit 2): rg: ... 拒绝访问。 (os error 5)
              已扫到的结果全部丢弃。"到底有没有？"——无从谈起。

find_file  →  matches: [ "C:\\...\\pdftotext.exe" ]        ← 照常返回
              skipped: [ { path: "...", code: "EPERM" }, … ]
              complete: false, incompleteReason: "permission-denied"
```

## 为什么需要它

DSH 内置 glob 工具把搜索委托给 ripgrep。在 Windows 上扫宽目录——`C:\Program Files`、用户主目录、盘根——几乎必然撞上系统级 ACL：`C:\Program Files\WindowsApps` 这类目录对普通进程就是拒绝访问，rg 以非零码退出，报错类似 `Error: glob search failed (exit 2): rg: ... 拒绝访问。 (os error 5)`。此时 glob 的行为是整次作废：只要 ripgrep 以 ≥2 的退出码结束，整条搜索连同已扫到的结果一起丢弃，模型拿到的只有这一条 Error。

真正的伤害在语义上：一次"因为权限失败"的搜索和一次"没找到"的搜索，在下游推理里很容易被混为一谈，于是"文件不存在"的错误结论就从一次失败的搜索里被顺手推出来了。本插件把"部分失败"当成一等结果：读不了的目录跳过（不中断搜索），连同 errno 一起写进结果；任何让覆盖不完整的因素——权限、时间预算、结果上限、深度上限——都会把 `complete` 置为 `false` 并给出 `incompleteReason`。这次搜索覆盖了多少、缺了哪一块，变成模型可以直接读到的事实，不用猜。

## 安装

两种方式都只动两个位置：profile 的 `node_modules` 下建一个目录联接（junction），`cordis.patch.yml` 末尾加一行插件声明。

### 方式一：install.ps1 一键装

```powershell
git clone https://github.com/Ronniealgo/dsh-find-file.git
cd dsh-find-file
powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File install.ps1              # 装进 desktop profile
powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File install.ps1 -Uninstall   # 卸载
```

脚本只做两件事：把本目录 junction 进 `%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\profiles\desktop\node_modules\dsh-find-file`，并在该 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 末尾追加 `- insert:` 块。每次改动前先写时间戳备份，`-Uninstall` 按同一算法把行删回去（备份保留，可逐字节还原）。`-Profile` 指定其它 profile，`-DshHome` 指定其它 DSH 主目录。

### 方式二：手动

1. 建联接（junction 不需要管理员权限）：

```powershell
New-Item -ItemType Junction -Path "$env:USERPROFILE\.dsh\profiles\desktop\node_modules\dsh-find-file" -Target "C:\path\to\dsh-find-file"
```

2. 在 `%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\profiles\desktop\cordis.patch.yml` 末尾追加（`config:` 可整体省略，四个键都有默认值）：

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: find-file
      name: dsh-find-file
      config:
        maxResults: 50
        timeBudgetMs: 90000
        maxDepth: 64
        includeDirs: false
```

3. 重启 DSH，到 设置 → 插件 里确认 dsh-find-file 已启用。

> 写错键名不会静默失效：未知配置键在插件加载时直接抛错（刻意设计，见「配置」）。

## 使用

### 作为 agent 工具（find_file）

工具注册后，必填参数只有两个：`root`（搜索起点，目录或单个文件）和 `pattern`（纯文件名模式：`*` 匹配任意长度，`?` 恰好一个字符，其余按字面匹配；不允许路径分隔符——要找子目录里的东西，就把 root 指到那个子目录）。四个上限可选。

```json
{
  "root": "C:\\Users\\me\\AppData",
  "pattern": "pdftotext.exe",
  "maxResults": 100
}
```

返回（真实字段）：

```json
{
  "root": "C:\\Users\\me\\AppData",
  "pattern": "pdftotext.exe",
  "matches": [
    "C:\\Users\\me\\AppData\\Local\\Programs\\poppler\\Library\\bin\\pdftotext.exe"
  ],
  "matchedCount": 1,
  "dirsWalked": 14120,
  "symlinkSkipped": 3,
  "skippedCount": 2,
  "skipped": [
    { "path": "C:\\Users\\me\\AppData\\Local\\Temp\\ipc-lock", "code": "EPERM" },
    { "path": "C:\\Users\\me\\AppData\\Roaming\\VendorX\\protected", "code": "EACCES" }
  ],
  "complete": false,
  "incompleteReason": "permission-denied",
  "elapsedMs": 8421,
  "limits": {
    "maxResults": 100,
    "timeBudgetMs": 90000,
    "maxDepth": 64,
    "includeDirs": false,
    "caseInsensitive": true
  }
}
```

字段速览：`matches` 是绝对路径（按遍历顺序，封顶 `maxResults`）；`dirsWalked` 是成功读取的目录数；`symlinkSkipped` 是看到但未跟随的符号链接/junction 数；`skipped` 是读不了的目录清单，每条带 errno 代码（最多列 30 条，总数看 `skippedCount`）；`limits` 是这次调用实际生效的上限。

工具返回给模型的文本块永远以 VERDICT 行收尾，例如：

```
find_file: 1 match(es) · 14120 dirs walked · 8421 ms · search INCOMPLETE (permission-denied)
  C:\Users\me\AppData\Local\Programs\poppler\Library\bin\pdftotext.exe
skipped 2 dir(s): C:\Users\me\AppData\Local\Temp\ipc-lock (EPERM); C:\Users\me\AppData\Roaming\VendorX\protected (EACCES)
symlinks/junctions not followed: 3
VERDICT: search incomplete — absence here is NOT proof of absence overall. Narrow the root or recheck before concluding.
```

### 作为 CLI

```powershell
node bin\find-file.mjs C:\Users\me\AppData pdftotext.exe --max-results 100
node bin\find-file.mjs C:\Users\me\Documents "*.pdf" --include-dirs --quiet
```

选项：`--max-results N`、`--time-budget-ms N`、`--max-depth N`、`--include-dirs`、`--case-sensitive`、`--quiet`（只打印匹配路径）。退出码：`0` = 搜索完成（0 个匹配也算完成）；`1` = 致命错误（root 访问不了）；`2` = 用法错误（参数或模式不合法）。

## complete 的语义（这个插件的核心）

- `complete: true`——预算内把 root 下整棵树读完。只有这时，`matchedCount: 0` 才允许下结论「该文件在此 root 下不存在」。
- symlink / junction 一律不跟随，计入 `symlinkSkipped`。这是刻意策略（Windows 上 junction 环会让天真的遍历永不终止），不算覆盖缺口，也不影响 `complete`。
- `complete: false`——搜索不完整，「没找到」不成立。`incompleteReason` 只有四个值：
  - `permission-denied`：有目录读不了，清单在 `skipped`；
  - `time-budget`：时间预算用尽；
  - `result-limit`：匹配数到达 `maxResults`；
  - `depth-limit`：树比 `maxDepth` 深。
- 实用规则：`complete: false` 时先缩小 root 或放宽上限重查，再谈存在与否。

## 配置

四个 entry config 键（写进 cordis.patch.yml 的 `config:` 块），每次调用可用同名参数覆盖：

| 键 | 范围 | 默认 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|---|
| `maxResults` | 1–1000 | `50` | 命中即停，标记 `result-limit` |
| `timeBudgetMs` | 1000–600000 | `90000` | 毫秒墙钟预算，用尽即停，标记 `time-budget` |
| `maxDepth` | 1–256 | `64` | root 下的目录层数，超过标记 `depth-limit` |
| `includeDirs` | `true` / `false` | `false` | 目录名也参与匹配；匹配到的目录仍会被深入遍历 |

- 越界数值会被夹回范围内（不是报错）；类型错误和未知键抛错。
- 未知键抛错是刻意设计：patch 里把 `maxResults` 拼成 `maxRsults`，必须炸在加载时，而不是静默退回默认值。
- `caseInsensitive` 不是 entry config 键；调用时可显式传，不传则按平台取默认——win32/darwin 不区分大小写，其余平台区分。CLI 对应 `--case-sensitive`。

## 与内置 glob 的对比

| | 内置 glob | `find_file` |
|---|---|---|
| 撞上读不了的目录 | 整次搜索作废，返回 `Error: glob search failed (exit 2)` | 跳过该目录继续搜，`skipped` 里记下 `{path, code}` |
| 已扫到的结果 | 全部丢弃 | 照常返回，`complete: false` 明示覆盖不完整 |
| 「没找到」的可信度 | 失败时无意义 | `complete: true` 且 0 匹配 ⇒ 确定不存在 |
| 部分覆盖的可见性 | 无 | `incompleteReason` 说明缺哪一类 |
| 匹配目标 | glob 模式匹配整条路径 | 纯文件名 `*` / `?`（不许路径分隔符） |
| 运行时依赖 | ripgrep 二进制 | 无（node:fs/promises + node:path） |

## 测试与开发

```bash
npm test        # 显式点名 4 个测试文件，零依赖，无需 npm install
npm run check   # node --check 全部源文件
```

要求 Node ≥ 20。引擎（lib/walk.js）的文件系统与时钟是注入的，单测不碰真实磁盘；CLI 测试会真实拉起 bin/find-file.mjs。更完整的来龙去脉见 [docs/MOTIVATION.md](docs/MOTIVATION.md)。

## 已知限制

- 不跟随 symlink/junction：链接目标下的树不会被覆盖（结果里以 `symlinkSkipped` 计数明示）。
- 只按文件名匹配：不做内容搜索，不支持 `a/**/b` 这类路径 glob。
- `skipped` 清单最多 30 条（`skippedCount` 始终准确）；`matches` 封顶 `maxResults`。
- 为 Windows ACL 场景设计；慢速网络盘靠 `timeBudgetMs` 兜底。

## 许可证

[MIT](LICENSE)

plugins.description: 在 DSH 右侧栏预览代码文件、按名字搜索工作区文件，并把选中行一键引用进对话框 ｜ Preview code files in the DSH sidebar, search workspace files by name, and reference the selected lines into the composer
plugins.readme_text: # 侧栏代码引用搜索工具（dsh-sidebar-editor） 在 DSH 右侧栏的文档面板里**彩色预览工作区代码文件**，并把**选中的行一键引用到对话框**。 可编辑与保存的能力仍在 bundle 里，但**默认关闭**（原因见下方「面板的形态：预览优先」）。 这是一个 DSH 插件 bundle（`dsh-sidebar-editor`），**免构建**：客户端半边是纯 classic script，宿主半边只注册一条路由。 ## 状态 预览、分类着色、行选、引用、右键菜单（含剪切/复制/粘贴/全选）、大文件降级、以及宿主保存路由**都已实现**； 其中编辑器与保存默认不启用。离线自检 `node E:\DSH\_tools\selfcheck-sidebar-editor.js` 覆盖 **300 项断言**（客户端）+ **29 项断言**（宿主路由）， 包含后缀覆盖契约、hook 顺序纪律、着色分类与注入防护、右键菜单、标准编辑项、三种引用形态、文件树行右键、拖选成范围、搜索面板、tab 条滚轮与自动揭露、 「出厂默认形态」、大文件降级边界、宿主路由的完整信封与全部失败码映射。 ## 它做了什么 - 注册文档预览实现 `dsh-sidebar-editor/code`，属于 `extension` 档。后缀的认领规则是： **内置「代码」渲染器认领的每一个后缀，我全都认领**，只排除被其他渲染器专门接管的那几个。 因为 `extension` 档排在 `builtin` 之前，**这些文件打开时默认就是编辑器**； 而内置「代码」渲染器仍然匹配同一个后缀，所以渲染器下拉里始终有它，随时可切回去看 Shiki 高亮。 这条规则同时保证了两件事：任何原本以只读代码视图打开的文件都不会"没有编辑器"， 且任何被我接管的文件都"有路可回"。 - 唯一的例外是刻意**不认领**其他内置渲染器已占用的后缀：`md`/`markdown`（Markdown 预览）、 `html`/`htm`（沙箱 HTML 预览）、`svg` 与位图（图片）、`pdf`、`xlsx`/`xls`/`csv`/`tsv`（表格）、 Office 文档 —— 认领它们会把这些文件的默认预览从用户手里抢走。 - 另外额外认领了十几个内置表里没有的文本后缀（`txt`、`astro`、`json5`、`sass`、`.gitignore`、 `.editorconfig`、`.npmrc`、`Cargo.lock` …）。这些文件我是唯一候选，所以**没有渲染器下拉**， 只能靠面板里的「只读」开关切换视图。自检里有一条断言把"超出内置表的后缀"限制在 20 个以内。 - 宿主半边注册一条精确 Fetch 路由 `POST /api/sidebarEditor/save`。 - 面板里没有任何 DSH 客户端包的 import：编辑器、行号槽、轻量高亮、地址解析全部自带， 颜色只用 `--dsw-alias-*` 与 `--shiki-token-*` 主题 token。 ### 面板能做什么 | 能力 | 说明 | |---|---| | 预览 | 自带分类着色（注释 / 字符串 / 数字与字面量 / 关键字 / 函数名与定义 / 装饰器与类名 / 属性 / 标点 / markup 标签与属性），按行渲染，可点选行 | | 选行 | 点一行选中、`Shift+点击` 扩选，**鼠标拖选任意多行**也直接成为引用范围；`已选 L5-L9` 实时显示 | | 右键 | 面板内的右键菜单是插件自绘的，除三种引用外还带 **剪切 / 复制 / 粘贴 / 全选**（预览形态只保留引用与「复制」）；右键某行会先把该行选为范围 | | 引用选中行 | 把 `@路径 L10-L20` 插入到对话输入框 | | 引用整个文件 | 工具条按钮与菜单项，插 `@路径`（不带行号） | | 引用所在目录 | 菜单项，插 `@目录/`（带尾斜杠）；文件就在工作区根目录时该项不出现 | | **文件树右键** | 直接在最右侧**文件树的行**上右键 → 「引用整个文件」/「引用这个目录」，外加「复制绝对路径」。不要求先打开面板 | | **文件面板搜索框** | 文件树的工具栏里（路径栏那一排的**最左**）多一个搜索框：输入即按名字匹配工作区文件（**文件与文件夹都匹配**），结果浮层列出「名字 + 所在目录」。点**文件**结果 → **先在文件树里展开到它、滚动进视野、高亮那一行，然后才打开该文件**；点**文件夹**结果 → 不打开任何东西，只在树里展开定位并高亮（已经展开的不再收起）。Esc 或点外面收起 | | **文件内查找** | 打开文件后，工具条上的「查找」按钮（面板有焦点时 Ctrl+F）：在当前文件内按行匹配、命中行加底色、1/N 行 计数、↑↓/Enter 逐个跳（到头回绕），跳到的行同时成为选中行，可直接引用 | | **搜索快捷键** | `Ctrl/Cmd+Shift+P` 打开「文件」tab 并聚焦搜索框（命令 `sidebarEditor.filesearch`）。键位在**设置 → 快捷键**（或 `Mod+/`）里改、清除、恢复默认，插件不持有键位副本 | | **条带滚动** | 右侧边栏 tab 开多了时：滚轮停在 tab 条上即左右滚动；新激活的 tab 会自动滚进视野（原来它只会停在视野外） | | 大文件 | 超过 4000 行时关闭着色只出纯文本，并在工具条上说明；行仍然可选可引用 | | 字号 | 工具条右侧的 `A− / A+` 步进器调**代码字号**，10–22px，默认 13px，选择会被记住 | | 编辑（默认关闭） | `
